summary: This class explains the order of reading for Hanukat HaBayit and clarifies how it differs from the Zohar reading for a Berit Milah. It details the text recited, including Pesukim, Mizmor Tehillim, Masechtot of Mishna, Zohar, Gemara, and Rambam, as well as affixing the Mezuza and saying Shehecheyanu. It also mentions a reading for rented apartments set apart by Hakham Yitzchak Alfiah.
